reason: The independent retest did not satisfy the zero-failure gate under severe host resource saturation.
observations: One concurrent audit timing gate exceeded 15 seconds without functional errors.
Three browser waits timed out while the requested pages returned HTTP 200 and retained no JavaScript, HTTP, Axe or external-network error.
Gunicorn worker timeout/SIGKILL events coincided with approximately 653 MiB of free host memory.
disposition: The probe supports environmental saturation as the cause but does not rehabilitate the rejected retest. No retry automation, timeout increase, assertion relaxation, source change or test change was used. A fresh candidate had to pass the complete sequence.
